QuestInfo.name: The Challenge
QuestInfo.0: You received a strange letter. What is it? Could it be...a love letter?
QuestInfo.1: The mysterious letter is actually a challenge. Someone wants to fight Mercedes, legendary hero and sovereign of the Elves. Hurry over to #b#m105040300##k. #rYou must enter Sleepywood through the portal at the Six Path Crossway to proceed.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated a man in a bamboo hat. Who was he? How did he know you? And who was he talking about? Maybe #p1012100# knows something about this.

0.0: #b(It's in elegant handwriting.)#k\r\nDear Mercedes, Ruler of the Elves, I challenge you. If you have any courage and value your honor, face me in Sleepywood. I'll be waiting.\r\nYours truly, #p1204020#

yes.0: #bHe dares challenge the ruler of the Elves? He'll rue the day he messed with Mercedes!#k #r(You can reach Sleepywood through the portal at the Six Path Crossway.)

no.0: #bDidn't Aran used to get letters like this all the time? Who does he think I am? Forget it!

1.0: Who was that? And what was he talking about?
